title: SAT-Pruned Quotient Proof-State CA
novelty_claim: Refine the proof-carrying CA lane into a cellular automaton whose cell alphabet is an e-graph-canonicalized local proof state and whose local rules are SAT-pruned so decoded spacetime blocks are already legal witness fragments. The novelty claim is narrow: exact no-repair decoding over the product-grid witness, not generic automation or symbolic search.
closest_prior_art: The repo's sat_egraph_symbolic_backbone and egraph_linear_span_rewriting branches
Generic automated mathematical search systems such as AlphaEvolve-style discovery loops
differentiation: This is the highest-novelty lane because the CA state itself is quotient proof data, the decoder contract is fixed and exact, and the fastest ablation is clean: hand the same SAT or e-graph pruning to a non-CA proposer and test whether the CA still adds anything.
easiest_falsifier: Kill immediately if exact-valid yield or verified-score gains disappear when the same SAT or e-graph pruning is used by a decoder-matched non-CA baseline, when canonical class IDs are randomized or ablated, or when X-labels are shuffled at fixed geometry.
evidence_plan: Phase 0: locate or recover the shared exact no-repair decoder or verifier for six-line (X,G,R,T) witnesses over Z; if absent, log the blocker and stop.
Enumerate one tiny SAT-constrained local-rule schema over quotient proof states and run one exact-valid-yield sweep on tiny legal grids.
Compare against random rule sampling and a decoder-matched non-CA proposer using the identical SAT or e-graph infrastructure and exact-decode budget.
Run canonicalization ablation, X-label shuffle, held-out geometry, held-out X, and small, medium, and unrestricted complexity checks before any promotion.

budget_envelope.scope: Champion lane only after verifier recovery.
budget_envelope.phase_0_gate: No search budget until a shared exact verifier or decoder is in use.
budget_envelope.candidate_limit: One SAT-constrained schema, at most 3 rule families, and at most 10^3 exact decodes per family for the first gate.
mandatory_controls: Decoder-matched non-CA baseline using the same SAT or e-graph pruning
X-label shuffle at fixed geometry and fixed nonzero-label multiset
Held-out larger or different-aspect-ratio grids plus at least one held-out legal X
Small, medium, and unrestricted complexity reporting
budget_envelope.promotion_gate: Promote only if exact-valid yield and verified-score distribution beat the decoder-matched baseline and the signal collapses under ablation or label shuffle.

title: Spatially Coupled Exact-Certificate Ladder CA
novelty_claim: Use tiny exact-valid witness fragments as stage-indexed macrocell templates and couple them across narrow interfaces so a boundary seed launches an exact singleton-certificate wave. The claim is only about exact verifier-visible score density, not proxy wave behavior.
closest_prior_art: Threshold-saturation and spatial-coupling ideas from coding theory
Local template propagation stories around arithmetic-Kakeya pattern problems
differentiation: This keeps the target on exact forcing pairs by restricting updates to verifier-legal certificate templates with stage ancestry. It is less novel than H1 because the coupling metaphor is familiar, but it is still distinct from generic percolation or heuristic peeling once the template bank is exact.
easiest_falsifier: Kill if coupled ladders fail to beat uncoupled repetition and random local search at matched exact budget, or if the gain survives X-label shuffle, randomized template banks, or held-out aspect ratios.
evidence_plan: Only open this lane after H1 has either produced an exact micro-gadget bank or been killed cleanly for non-coupling reasons.
Extract singleton-certificate templates from tiny exact-valid witnesses and encode stage ancestry explicitly in the cell state.
Compare coupled versus uncoupled ladders, random local search, and whole-witness mutation under identical exact-decode budgets.
Require failure under template randomization and X-label shuffling before treating any gain as arithmetic rather than geometric.

budget_envelope.scope: Backup lane contingent on an exact micro-gadget bank.
budget_envelope.phase_0_gate: Do not open before the exact verifier exists and at least one tiny exact-valid fragment family is available.
budget_envelope.candidate_limit: One micro-gadget family, 6-10 coupled slabs, and at most 10^3 exact decodes per comparison family for the first gate.
mandatory_controls: Random local search and whole-witness mutation baselines
budget_envelope.promotion_gate: Promote only if the coupled construction improves verified-score distribution over uncoupled and non-CA baselines and the effect disappears under template randomization or label shuffle.

title: Interface-Typed Macrocell Grammar CA
novelty_claim: Make recursive constructibility itself the automaton alphabet: each macrocell boundary encodes legal copy-glue interfaces, active X membership, and singleton-certificate exposure, so local CA updates assemble only decode-ready witness pieces. The novelty is representational rather than asymptotic, and it only survives if exact score improves without hiding work in the interface library.
closest_prior_art: Static tiling or grammar encodings of recursive witnesses
differentiation: This is the cleanest answer to the constructibility-native representation gap, but it has the largest implementation surface and the highest risk that the grammar or decoder, not the CA, is doing the work. That makes it a reserve branch rather than the first active lane.
easiest_falsifier: Kill if cooperative interface typing does not beat independent local matching or static grammar enumeration at matched exact budget, or if the apparent gain survives label shuffle and decoder ablation.
evidence_plan: Open only if H1 fails for search-efficiency reasons and H2 fails for coupling-specific reasons.
Freeze a small library of exact-valid macrocells with verifier-legal proof fragments on the boundaries.
Compare macrocell CA rollout against flat CA, static grammar enumeration, and random defect grammars on 3x3 then held-out 4x4 or 5x5 macroboards.
Audit whether any gain survives interface randomization, decoder ablation, or X-label shuffling.

budget_envelope.phase_0_gate: No promotion unless exact verifier recovery is complete and H1 and H2 have failed cleanly.
budget_envelope.candidate_limit: 8-16 macrocell types, one 3x3 pilot block, and one held-out 4x4 or 5x5 block before review.
mandatory_controls: X-label shuffle and held-out board-shape checks
budget_envelope.promotion_gate: Promote only if macrocell typing yields better exact-valid rate and verified-score density than both flat CA and static grammar baselines without decoder leakage.
